assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Atherosclerotic heart disease is coded as I25.10.
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded as I34.0.
The CPT code for the service is 93229.
The service is ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate-control management.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197.
